purpose: Allow one verified physician's bound apprentice to temporarily read one current patient's scoped vault during a care task without copying patient content into physician permanent knowledge.
open_preconditions: physician apprentice node teacher_subject_code equals logged-in doctor display_code
active care relationship with the selected patient
active system authorization basis covering exact purpose and data categories
active vault owned by the selected patient
requested duration is between 1 and 240 minutes
read_rules: The access session binds exactly one doctor, one physician agent, one patient and one vault.
Each read rechecks access session, doctor login session, care relationship and authorization-basis status and expiry.
Only entries in the approved data categories are returned.
The query and returned patient content are not written to the access session or audit log.
Closing, expiry, login revocation, relationship end or authorization revocation prevents subsequent reads.
forbidden: reuse an access session for another patient
persist raw patient content into physician knowledge
expand scope from a client role or model request
continue reading after close, expiry or revocation
treat AI output as a signed diagnosis or prescription
production_gates: human technical, clinical, legal and privacy approval
